items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: Cornish was on trombone and we had Wood and Joe playing Cornish. That was the lineup, you know, in that band. And I played with him a while.

ctx.x: I've seen the name and the picture of their band.

Yeah, well I played with them and then Sam and Cornish got in a little misunderstanding and he split up. And Cornish made up his own band, well I went with Cornish. And I left off a clarinet then and went on sax, and John went in the band on clarinet. Cornish was on trombone and we had Wood and Joe playing Cornish. That was the lineup, you know, in that band. And I played with him a while. And finally Jack Kerris band made a split. And at that time his name was Fame around here, you know. Yeah, her mother, Punchy…
